summary: English single-report template of Clinic D on the manufacturer's master: a two-address letterhead, an executive summary of fill-in tables and a recommendation form, a table of contents, the master chapters with z-score maps, theta/beta and central sensitivity tables, and a long clinic-typed lifestyle and therapy chapter with named signatories. It has no AI interpretation markers.

theme.cover: letterhead: page 1 starts with two framed address text boxes and a centred logo above the executive summary; no running header or footer on page 1

fonts.families: theme fonts Trebuchet MS and Calibri; runs set to Calibri, Tahoma for complex script, Trebuchet MS in a few places
fonts.sizes_pt: mostly 11, also 12, 8, 14, 10 and 13; summary headings up to 18; hidden control line 1

colours: light cyan cells in the evoked response summary table
dark blue and mid blue text in places
header: patient slots (last name, first name, birth date)
footer: company line (name of a partner company of the manufacturer)

images.other: 11 placements of 10 static localisation pictures in the ICA component tables; 3 signature images (one as an embedded legacy photo-editor object); 1 picture bullet; 1 tiny theme fill image; text boxes: 2 letterhead boxes, 3 legend boxes, 1 footer box

theme_gaps: different first page: letterhead page without running header and footer
two-address letterhead built from floating text boxes around an inline logo
running header with patient slots (name, birth date) and a page number field, from page 2
footer as a floating text box
automatic heading numbering (roman chapters, arabic sections, letter subsections), used by the table of contents
36 manual page breaks; spectra headings, legends and figures share one paragraph per condition
summary pages built from bordered tables with shaded header cells and tick-box symbols
picture bullet in a list style
legend text coloured to match the fixed device curve colours

review_response.finding: numbers 0, completeness 1: coverage counted only not_expressible elements while listed gaps sat in elements classed as covered
